title: Identification of different functions of CD8+ T cell subpopulations by a monoclonal antibody
description: The goal is to investigate the difference of functional activities between FE-1H10+ CD8+ T cells and FE-1H10- CD8+ T cells. We confirmed the difference of these two subpopulations by determining the different levels of gene expressions by RNA sequencing.
